paper.title_en: Gradient-flow scale setting from octet baryon masses in N$^3$LO covariant chiral perturbation theory
paper.abstract_en: We determine the gradient-flow scale $t_0$ by analyzing the lowest-lying octet-baryon masses on the Coordinated Lattice Simulations (CLS) $N_f=2+1$ ensembles in covariant baryon chiral perturbation theory up to next-to-next-to-next-to leading order (N$^3$LO). By including the finite-volume corrections self-consistently and the discretization effects from Symanzik effective field theory, we obtain a good description of the RQCD data and determine the gradient-flow scale to be $\sqrt{8t_{0,\mathrm{ph}}}=0.4120(14)_\mathrm{stat.}(16)_\mathrm{sys.}$ fm with sub-percent precision. The predicted octet baryon masses agree well with the experimental values in the isospin limit. Using the Feynman-Hellmann theorem, we also estimate the nucleon sigma terms, which are consistent with direct determinations from three-point correlation functions on the same CLS ensembles.
